newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon bans trucks as pollution rises.
newsitem.headline: Lyon bans trucks as pollution rises.

text.p: Authorities banned trucks from driving through Lyon, France's second largest city, on Thursday when cold weather combined with a lack of wind raised pollution to danger levels for the third successive day.
The office of the prefect (government representative) banned trucks of over 7.5 tonnes from the motorway crossing through the city and diverted them to a ring road.
It also recommended that cars skirt the city.

The prefect maintained for the second successive day a ban on school sports and asked elderly people to avoid efforts in order to prevent breathing problems from the high contamination by nitrogen dioxide, due mostly to exhaust fumes.
The cold weather and lack of wind have raised contamination to alert levels in Paris, Le Havre and the Marseille area this week.
